sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

reply.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hallo, as promised I checked the numbers again and sharpened my pencil. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price.

Our offer is a price of €15.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. 

As an alternative: If you give me 14 days payment so I can buy the steel, I can do 14.90 EUR. That option means a price of €14.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP.

Let me know if we have a deal so we can get the machines running.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

Your brief quote and mention of getting back to the machines suggest you value a straightforward discussion without unnecessary back-and-forth. We want a competitive price and delivery arrangements that work for your production schedule. How could flexibility on delivery and payment timing help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. But you asked about payment: if you pay in 14 days, it helps us buy the steel. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. We have free capacity for your parts. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium.

Our offer is a price of €15.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. With 14 days payment, your 42 days lead time and DAP, I can do 15.40 EUR. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
